label: Продукт
description: A 10-sentence usage card for продукт (product; food).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Продукт' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' points at it and 'свежий' is the agreeing adjective. A clean model for describing food quality.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Продукт' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'купил', identical to the nominative. 'Полезный' agrees in the masculine accusative. A practical shopping sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Продукта' is genitive after 'нет' to express that the item is unavailable. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'в магазине' is prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Dative after an adjective. 'Продукту' is dative, the thing the children are glad about, governed by 'рады'. 'Новому' agrees in the masculine dative. A useful pattern for reactions.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Продуктом' is instrumental after 'со' to mark what the cook works with. 'Свежим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A natural kitchen phrase.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В продукте' uses the prepositional form 'продукте' after 'в' to mark what contains the vitamins. 'Много витаминов' is a genitive plural quantity. Useful for nutrition talk.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Продукт' is the nominative predicate noun linked by the dash. 'Полезный' is the agreeing adjective. A clean equational sentence for definitions.

missions.phrase: Мы покупаем свежие продукты каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Продукты' is the inanimate accusative plural of 'покупаем', matching the nominative plural. 'Свежие' agrees, and 'каждый день' adds frequency. Often means groceries.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Продукты' is the nominative plural subject of 'закончились'. 'В холодильнике' is prepositional location. A common everyday observation about running out of food.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of absence. 'Продуктов' is the genitive plural after 'нет' to express absence. 'Молочных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в корзине' is prepositional location.
